Lemma
[Metric-Preserving Maps in Equal Dimensions Are Local Diffeomorphisms]

↗ def:metric-preserving ↗ lem:metric-preserving-immersion ↗ thm:inverse-function-theorem-manifolds

If $M$ and $\widetilde M$ have equal dimension and $\varphi :M\to \widetilde M$ is smooth with $\varphi ^*\widetilde g=g$, then $\varphi $ is a local diffeomorphism.
Proof

↗ lem:metric-preserving-immersion ↗ thm:inverse-function-theorem-manifolds \sketch Lemma 3 makes $d\varphi _p$ injective; equal finite dimensions make it invertible. The inverse function theorem, Theorem thm:inverse-function-theorem-manifolds, then gives a local diffeomorphism at every $p$.

□
